verdict.rationale: FreshBooks' own accounting page says founders can grant their accountant access to real-time data, and that the accountant can update journal entries and the chart of accounts, run reports and file taxes. This covers the review-and-adjust core of the story. However, the evidence never describes how the invite works or what permission levels exist, so the role-scoped part is only implied by the accountant-specific framing. missing for 10: documented invitation flow, explicit role/permission scoping for accountant users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: Grant your accountant access to real-time data in one central location

Your accountant will be able to update your journal entries and chart of accounts, giving you the most accurate view of your financial health. From there, they can run reports, file taxes, and help you make smart business decisions.
making informed business decisions alongside your accountant
